title: Jayden Daniels on Stefon Diggs penalty: We have to be smarter

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jayden Daniels on Stefon Diggs penalty: We have to be smarter
sources.description: The Commanders drew within two points of the Eagles on a Stefon Diggs touchdown with 9:59 left to play on Sunday, but any thoughts of tying the game went away seconds after the wideout entered the end zone.
